female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

family-mention-interaction.title: Mentioning family obligations and benefits has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
family-mention-interaction.body: Pitches from women that highlight family or community benefits fund faster, while pitches from men that mention family obligations or school fees fund more slowly.

institutional-detail-slower.title: Mentioning local currency amounts or specific institutional affiliations predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-detail-slower.body: Pitches that include specific local currency figures or name the microfinance institution tend to experience slower funding speeds for both men and women.

female-child-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who list the specific ages of their children fund faster.
female-child-age-faster.body: Providing precise ages for children in the pitch text is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-age-mention-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their own age fund faster.
female-age-mention-faster.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's specific age are associated with increased funding speed.

female-shorter-pitch-faster.body: Female borrowers who write shorter pitches may fund faster in categories like education and food.

male-hardship-detail-slower.body: Male borrowers who provide specific details about current hardships fund more slowly.

female-mother-label-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly describe themselves as a mother may fund more slowly.

female-debt-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention existing debts or arrears may fund more slowly.

female-married-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention being married may fund more slowly.

female-challenges-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific challenges facing the borrower may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders or institutions may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention previous loans or promise prompt repayment may fund more slowly.

female-geo-location-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific geographic locations (e.g., in the Philippines) may fund faster.

female-low-local-amount-faster.title: Female borrowers requesting lower amounts of local currency may fund faster than those requesting higher amounts.

female-thanks-slower.title: Female borrowers who express explicit thanks to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-aspirational-language-slower.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language like 'dreams' for their family's future may fund more slowly.
female-aspirational-language-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that desires for a happy life or bright future for children accelerate funding.

female-geo-location-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific geographic location in their pitch may fund faster.
female-geo-location-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-single-status-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly describe themselves as single women may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-promise-faster.title: Female borrowers who make a direct promise to repay the loan promptly may fund faster.

female-previous-kiva-loan-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention having previously received a Kiva loan may fund faster.
female-previous-kiva-loan-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning previous loans correlates with slower funding.

female-boilerplate-slower.title: Pitches from women that employ standardized, repetitive, or generic phrasing to describe their work ethic or professional role correlate with slower funding speeds.
female-boilerplate-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim regarding age specificity.

male-thanks-faster.title: Male borrowers who express explicit thanks to lenders may fund faster.
male-thanks-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle after 68 batches without corroboration.

female-child-count-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the number of children they have may fund more slowly.
female-child-count-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific counts of children appear in faster pitches.
